job.job_title: Site Reliability Engineer - Python & GenAI Platforms
job.job_description:
Dear Candidate!




Greetings from TCS !!!




Role: Site Reliability Engineer - Python & GenAI Platforms




Location: Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Delhi




Experience Range: 6 to 10 Years




Job Description:



GenAI Capabilities (Mandatory)
Experience supporting LLM-based applications in production
Familiarity with:
Prompt engineering basics
RAG-based systems
LLM APIs (OpenAI, Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock)
Understanding of:
LLM failure modes (hallucination, latency, rate limits)
Cloud & Platform Experience (Mandatory)
Hands-on experience with:
AWS and/or GCP
Experience with:
Kubernetes (EKS/GKE preferred)
Docker
Familiarity with serverless and microservices architecture
Observability & Automation
Experience with monitoring tools:
Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK stack
Strong scripting/automation skills
Incident management and troubleshooting expertise



TCS has been a great pioneer in feeding the fire of Young Techies like you. We are a global leader in the technology arena and there's nothing that can stop us from growing together.
